# VLM photo-source fixtures

These pinned files expand the photo-scene gate benchmark with independent, visually difficult sources: monochrome lunar soil, low-color planetary imagery, dark space scenes, night photography, panoramas, scientific composites, snow, forest, fog, and desert photographs.

`manifest.json` records the source page, exact asset URL, provider, author or credit, license basis, and SHA-256 digest for every file. NASA assets are reviewed against NASA's media usage guidelines. Wikimedia Commons records were selected only when the Commons API reported CC0 and no attribution requirement; the manifest preserves the author credit even though CC0 does not require it.

The corpus builder verifies every digest before deriving a 720×480 clean/watermarked pair. The overlays are generated by this repository and are not part of the originals. No file in this directory contains user data or a project secret.
